name: Proxy decks
description: Proxy decks people share on r/mpcproxies, Ko-fi and Discord – real Magic cards with new art and frames – from their Google Drive, and proxy folders or zips on your PC. Import a deck, see each card full size, tick the ones you want and add them to your deck: they're printed with those pictures, and every picture keeps its maker's credit. Paste a link or a whole post and the details are found for you.
